request.style: English, warm female solo voice with soft choir support, acoustic guitar, piano, cello, gentle percussion, peaceful and reflective mood, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Ner fathered Kish
Kish fathered Saul
Saul fathered Jonathan
Malchishua Abinadab
Eshbaal followed on
The line of the house
Was kept in the book
Of the tribe of Benjamin

[Chorus]
Azel had six sons
And these are their names
Azrikam and Bocheru
Ishmael and Sheariah
Obadiah and Hanan
All these were the sons

[Verse]
Jonathan had Merib-baal
Merib-baal fathered Micah
Pithon Melech and Tarea
Ahaz was his son
Jehoaddah came next
Alemeth Azmaveth
Zimri fathered Moza
Moza fathered Binea

[Chorus]
Azel had six sons
And these are their names
Azrikam and Bocheru
Ishmael and Sheariah
Obadiah and Hanan
All these were the sons

[Bridge]
Raphah was his son
Eleasah his son
Azel was his son
The record is clear
In chapter nine again
The names are listed
Six sons of Azel
The lineage is true

[Chorus]
Azel had six sons
And these are their names
Azrikam and Bocheru
Ishmael and Sheariah
Obadiah and Hanan
All these were the sons

[Outro]
Sheariah is named
In the royal house
The descendants of Saul
Are preserved in song
